If `CommandLineOptions` does not include a --threads option, `--threads=auto,1` is appended automatically, giving the Julia session a dedicated interactive thread alongside its default thread pool. Without a dedicated interactive thread, HTTP.jls server tasks share Julia's single thread with whatever expression is currently being evaluated, which can leave the server unable to respond to Excel - or even to shut down cleanly - while a long-running or blocking evaluation is in progress.
